premises.text: Nav apps precompute routes and assume traffic stays fixed during a drive, so they miss the true fastest path and reroute often
premises.evidence_span: They assume traffic doesn't change during the course of your drive

premises.text: Minute-level traffic data from sources like loop detectors enables truly real-time routing
premises.evidence_span: minute-level traffic data ingestion, prediction, accidents, and routing

premises.text: Time-dependent routing prices each road stretch by when the driver is expected to reach each turn
premises.evidence_span: time-dependent routing, where the cost of each stretch of road is calculated based on when you're actually expected to reach each turn

premises.text: Businesses that move people or goods lack embeddable real-time turn-by-turn navigation and rely on costly workarounds
premises.evidence_span: embeddable navigation simply doesn't exist today

premises.text: A Navigation SDK lets any company embed real-time turn-by-turn navigation into existing apps with minimal code
premises.evidence_span: any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

value.text: Actual fastest routes and in-app real-time navigation for businesses that move people or things
value.evidence_span: This ensures we find the actual fastest route
